# Contextual carrier with a plain nominal bound

One invariant input/result carrier retains the method formal's single known
class or interface bound. At least one independent fixed nominal context is
required; scalar auxiliaries bind no formal. Public, package nested
and virtual entries keep raw call arguments, actual mutations and opaque results.

Frozen source, package-source and SDK profiles compare field and result snapshots,
distinct and aliased lists, live set effects, ignored calls, the original nominal
element cast, late result casts, null order and exact checked/Error identity.
Wrong programs must fail the observer and original compiler metadata is retained.
